lines.en: between the observer and the observed becomes equal to the sum of the bodies of both, it is the beginning of the conjunction, because at this time

lines.text: و انرا مرآئیه قوي الانصراف خوانند و چون بقدر نصف مجموع جرمين شود
lines.en: and they call it the mirror of strong separation. And when it becomes equal to half the sum of the two bodies,

lines.text: غایت قوّت انصراف بود انرا لاجرم تام الانصراف گویند و چون کوکبی ببرج

lines.text: مثل شخصي بود بشهري در آيد و هيچکس را نه بيند لاجرم وحشت بر طبیعت او غالب
lines.en: is like a person who enters a city and sees no one, necessarily wildness overcomes his nature,

lines.text: گردد و اینوضع دلیل بود بر فرو ماندن از کارها و نقصان اموال و پیش آمدن مهمات
lines.en: and this position is a sign of being stuck in affairs, and loss of wealth, and the occurrence of important matters

lines.text: بي نفع و اگر چنانکه کوکب متصل نشود و بعد از ان انتقال بلا اتصال هم در آن برج بکوکبی

lines.en: that sign it is, they call it empty of motion, far from conjunction. And these states most of the time happen to the moon

lines.text: در برج قوسی باشد زیرا که اضعف بروج غربیه است مر قمر را بسبب انکه برج قوسی واسطه

summary.headline: Conjunction, Separation, and Wild Motion
summary.text: Rules for the beginnings and degrees of planetary conjunction and separation, including complete separation and the mirror of strong separation. Defines wild in motion, far from conjunction, and empty of motion, especially for the Moon in Sagittarius, and introduces pushing of strength through the five lines.
